content: दीक्षारम्भ 2026. Fourth Batch of Students Joining university in presence of Hon'ble Chief Justice of Tripura, Hon'ble Justice M.S. Ramachandrarao and other eminent persons Hon'ble Justice S D Purkayastha and Chairman, State Bar Council, Tripura.
comment: Legal education gains depth when students see beyond classrooms—early exposure to courts, ethics and practical advocacy can shape professionals who understand both law and its impact.
